target_expected_signal.criterion: concurrent requests produce the prohibited duplicate or out-of-order state transition

expected_signal.criterion: the same transport, identity, parser, browser, callback, or timing channel produces its declared harmless baseline
an inert same-shape input does not produce the target security effect

impact_rules.boundary: credit a boundary only when controlled timing or concurrency changes a protected outcome
impact_rules.sensitivity: cite the resulting data, state, cache, or protocol effect rather than latency alone
impact_rules.actor_requirements: score request count, concurrency, authentication, and timing precision required
